brief: Check who receives financial data and how consent can be withdrawn before enabling a sharing service.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Data Consent"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee consentimiento de datos financieros"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia consentimento de dados financeiros"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Check who receives financial data and how consent can be withdrawn before enabling a sharing service.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A sharing service needs more than a quick tap; inspect the recipient, data scope, purpose and withdrawal process.
instruction.misconception: Installing an app explains all data sharing or withdrawing consent necessarily erases every previously shared record.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Before consent, check recipient, data, purpose, duration and withdrawal steps. Do not assume withdrawal erases information already shared.
A consent decision needs an identified data recipient.
Data scope and purpose define what consent would permit.
Stopping future sharing is part of understanding the permission.
Removing software does not establish the sharing permission’s status.
Stopping future access does not prove earlier records were erased.
A clear purpose alone does not explain who receives data.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
